description: Place parts by their connections as ONE change: every part without a position, or only some parts or one instance. Placed and locked parts stay. Connectors go on the nearest edge; a part's pcbEdge (left, right, top, bottom) picks one. Run it before autoroute. With fit: true a part with no room grows the board.

connectors.description: last (default): connectors after the rest; ahead: each just before the part it serves

fit.description: Also fit the board round the parts

name: autoplace
